```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/assets/vendor/leaflet/leaflet.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/assets/css/citation-map.css">
<script defer src="/assets/vendor/leaflet/leaflet.js"></script>
<script defer src="/assets/js/citation-map.js"></script>
<figure class="citation-map" data-citation-map data-source="/assets/data/citation-geography.json" aria-labelledby="citation-map-caption">
  <div class="citation-map__summary" aria-live="polite">Loading citation geography…</div>
  <div class="citation-map__toolbar">
    <div class="citation-map__modes" role="group" aria-label="Group citing affiliations by">
      <button type="button" data-map-mode="regions" aria-pressed="true">States / provinces</button>
      <button type="button" data-map-mode="institutions" aria-pressed="false">Institutions</button>
    </div>
    <button class="citation-map__reset" type="button" data-map-reset aria-label="Reset map to world view">World view <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button>
  </div>
  <div class="citation-map__canvas" aria-label="Citation affiliation map. Use arrow keys to pan and plus or minus to zoom." aria-describedby="citation-map-help"></div>
  <div class="citation-map__under">
    <div class="citation-map__legend" aria-label="Circle size indicates the number of citing papers"></div>
    <span id="citation-map-help" class="citation-map__hint">Select a point to explore. Zoom in for institutions.</span>
  </div>
  <div class="citation-map__location">
    <label for="citation-location">Find a place</label>
    <select id="citation-location" data-map-location aria-label="Find a state, province, or institution"><option value="">Choose a state or province</option></select>
  </div>
  <figcaption id="citation-map-caption">
    <p class="citation-map__coverage" data-map-coverage></p>
    <details class="citation-map__method">
      <summary>Counting and location details</summary>
      <p>Each external citing paper is counted once in each state, province, or institution represented by its authors’ affiliations. A paper with affiliations in several places appears in each, so place counts do not sum to the number of papers. Direct self-citations and non-research records, such as tables of contents, are excluded.</p>
      <p>State and province markers use the location of the most-cited mapped institution in that region. Institution locations come from affiliation records and may represent a main campus or city. Missing or unresolved affiliations are not assigned a location.</p>
      <p>Citation and affiliation records come from <a href="https://openalex.org/">OpenAlex</a>, with citation links cross-checked against <a href="https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=keb-zTsAAAAJ&amp;hl=en">Google Scholar</a>. Missing region names are completed from known institution coordinates using <a href="https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/10m-cultural-vectors/10m-admin-1-states-provinces/">Natural Earth</a> boundaries. Counts reflect the records available on the update date.</p>
      <p>The source collection contains 15 DOI-verified works: 14 listed in my Google Scholar profile and one additional publisher-verified work. Google Scholar totals can differ because its coverage and indexing differ.</p>
    </details>
  </figcaption>
  <noscript><p>This interactive map needs JavaScript. The <a href="/assets/data/citation-geography.json">aggregated citation geography</a> remains available as a data file.</p></noscript>
</figure>
```
